tool_args.rationale: The supplied six observations vary u_now and s_grad but hold the other covariates fixed, supporting a compact smooth two-input response. A bilinear model has four fitted coefficients and can be estimated from the six rows; no high-frequency oscillation signature is present. The prediction function assumes the harness provides training rows globally as _TRAIN_ROWS, which is not defined by this implementation.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Already acquired in the supplied history; its added observation provides a sixth point, so repeating a probe is unnecessary.
All rows share H=0.6 and the pilot signatures indicate smooth monotone-concave behavior, not unresolved fast temporal dynamics.
It is explicitly nuisance data and does not resolve the observed input-response relation.

The available rows vary both u_now and s_grad; the simple one-dimensional Haldane form omits gradient dependence, while the multiplicative power law is not better identified by these six mixed samples.
